subject: The registration deadlines are coming
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
MS NOW: ‘The largest investment ever’: DNC launches voter registration drive [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=070526_2&amount=30]
The 2025 elections showed us a valuable truth, folks: Voter participation is increasing in all the right ways.
Voter registration activity increased across the country. According to the team at National Voter Registration Day, New York recorded more registrations for their 2025 events than in 2024, and California saw similar increases. Earlier this fall it looked like voter participation was going to make a real jump, even in a so-called "off-year".
Then Election Day came. New Jersey had more voters turn out for a gubernatorial election than they had in 20 years. Crucial counties in Pennsylvania saw their highest turnout levels in almost 15 years. New York City reached a turnout percentage unseen in over five decades.
We can drive even higher levels of participation when voters understand the stakes and feel like their vote matters , just like it did last November. That's why our voter registration efforts are so important, and why we work on it all year long.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=070526_2&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=070526_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=070526_2&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=070526_2&amount=50]

The key is getting young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever. Pundits in Virginia said they could have called the election results when they saw the first turnout numbers from the major college campus locations around the state. That's the kind of impact these young voters can have.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The upcoming midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- can be game-changing. Can you pitch in with $30 or however much you can to help us register a tidal wave of new voters ahead of this year's voter registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=070526_2&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=070526_2&amount=20]

For the good of the country, we're going on offense. Jay Feely (AZ-01): A former professional football kicker and strong Trump ally, Jay will fight to keep our border secure, deport illegal aliens, and kick the Swamp into shape. Kevin Lincoln (CA-13): A Mayor, pastor, and Marine who served the President of the United States on Marine One, Kevin has dedicated his life to serving his community and country. Joe Mitchell (IA-02): A non-profit leader who also worked under President Trump's Administration, Joe will fight to protect our farmers and end the Democrats' reckless spending. Paul LePage (ME-02): A two-time elected Governor of Maine whose American Dream story began sleeping in horse stables after becoming homeless at 11, Paul will end wasteful Democrat spending and bring back American jobs. Laurie Buckhout (NC-01): A retired Army Colonel and decorated combat commander from a long line of combat veterans, Laurie will fight to support our Veterans and make sure they receive the care they deserve when their mission is complete. Mike LiPetri (NY-03): A Conservative former New York State Assemblyman and champion of law enforcement, Mike will fight the pro-crime Democrats and help dismantle gangs trafficking fentanyl into our communities. Peter Oberacker (NY-19): A successful businessman from the Hudson Valley, Peter will fight to win this critical swing district and focus on bringing down the costs of groceries, utilities, and gas. Tano Tijerina (TX-28): A born and raised South Texan, Tano learned the importance of faith, family, and hard work. As a county judge, Tano locked away hardened criminals and will continue to fight to support law enforcement and the American Dream. Eric Flores (TX-34): A US Army Veteran, Eric will be a champion for our veterans, fight to keep the border secure, and put a stop to migrant crime in our communities. Greg Cunningham (NM-02): A Marine Veteran and law enforcement officer, Greg will fight for law enforcement, bring down the costs of energy, and keep the Southern border secure. John Braun (WA-03): A retired Navy Captain and job-creating manufacturer, John will fight to create more American jobs. Eric Conroy (OH-01): An Air Force Captain Veteran who answered the call when the Twin Towers fell on 9/11, Eric will fight for working families and revitalize Main Street America. Jim Desmond (CA-48): A Navy Veteran and commercial pilot, Jim will fight to lower costs and deliver safer communities. Brinker Harding (NE-02): An Omaha business leader, Brinker will rein in wasteful spending in Washington and work to reduce the National debt. body:
The ties that hold us together—even when everything else pulls us apart
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/scu0ffaf9e6)
---
**July 5, 2026** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
_**America turned 250. You showed us how Colorado celebrated.**_
We asked how you spent the Fourth, and you answered with [photos from across Colorado and beyond](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sdv971542b6) — from Washington and the Monterey coast to Delta County, Aspen, Castle Rock, Westminster and Palisade, where wildfire smoke finally lifted. We wove them together with the founders' own words in our editorial, The bonds that cannot be dissolved. Thank you to everyone who shared a photo or video. You made this story possible.
Our editorial this week centered on a simple but profound idea.
The Declaration of Independence began by dissolving political ties to a king. But it ended by creating something even stronger—a promise among ordinary Americans to pledge "our Lives, our Fortunes and our sacred Honor" to one another. [Two hundred fifty years later, those bonds still matter.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sdja9c6e4a9)
This week reminded us that while politics often divides us, love of country still has an incredible way of bringing Americans together. And perhaps that's exactly what we need more of.
Read the full editorial ➡️ _**[The bonds that cannot be dissolved](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s6ndd7ab5a7)**_
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s4q372b4804)
**Now let's look at the top 3 stories on social media this week:**
🔥 **C**[**olorado ignored the warning. Now the aspens are disappearing**.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s1gcdc6bb80) _Nearly three decades ago, experts warned that decades of fire suppression would fundamentally change Colorado's forests. Today, many of those predictions have become reality, with aspen stands disappearing, wildfire risks increasing, and water supplies suffering as conifers replace one of Colorado's most iconic trees. It's a fascinating look at how today's environmental challenges were predicted years ago—and why forest management matters now more than ever._
🗳️ **[RNC sues Griswold over overseas voter policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sfnc3366c6f)** _Just days before Colorado's primary election, the Republican National Committee filed suit against Secretary of State Jena Griswold, arguing the state's policy allowing certain overseas voters with no personal Colorado residency history to vote violates the Colorado Constitution's residency requirements. The lawsuit adds another chapter to Colorado's ongoing debate over election law and election integrity._
🎥 **[Nick Shirley: "Follow the money. Knock on the doors."](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s8p584062cf)** _At Freedom Fest, independent journalist Nick Shirley shared how some of his biggest investigations began—not with anonymous sources or leaked documents—but simply by asking questions, showing up, and looking for himself. His message to Coloradans was straightforward: if something doesn't seem right, investigate it, ask questions, and never stop seeking the truth._
As always, thank you for trusting Rocky Mountain Voice to tell Colorado's stories.

In truth & liberty,
Team RMV
| | |
---
| | **TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK**
---
**[Nick Shirley’s message to Colorado: Follow the money. Knock on the doors.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sdo7c37c1cb)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sbrb2488200) Nick Shirley spent Saturday night walking the Freedom Fest audience through the questions that have taken him from hotels near Denver International Airport to empty daycare centers in Minnesota and apartment complexes in Aurora.
**[How one volunteer connected the dots at RMV’s Freedom Fest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sfoc99e8eec)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s4ke4d5f22f)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s0kf84a1787) After Freedom Fest ended, Pueblo resident Randy Thurston was still talking his way through the weekend. Not in order. One speaker reminded him of another, and a story from Saturday connected to something he had heard Friday. He was not replaying the event. He was still putting it together.
**[They almost stayed home: What a Douglas County couple took away from RMV’s Freedom Fest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s8h83b8c934)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s8i5cc17398)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s9l89925cd7) By Saturday morning, Russ and Deb Minary were home, a refrigerator due to be delivered and an ordinary weekend resuming around them. They couldn’t stop replaying the day before. They almost hadn’t gone.
|
---
**STATE**
**[Money didn’t win Colorado’s primary. The ground game did.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s7tc9219d8d)** BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s2m2978588e) _One of Colorado’s biggest races still isn’t settled. Two days after the polls closed, the Republican primary for governor had not been called. Victor Marx led Barb Kirkmeyer by about 2,000 votes statewide—39.86 percent to 39.43 percent, with Scott Bottoms third at 20.71 percent—in the Secretary of State’s Thursday morning count. Marx’s edge, 2,181 votes out of more than 500,000 cast, sits just outside Colorado’s mandatory recount range, which trips at half a percentage point._
**[Colorado’s dirty voter roll: Getting on is the easy part](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sbs7ad61f26)** BY MIKE O'DONNELL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sbv0827d058) _I’ve spent the last few months digging deeply into the Colorado voter roll from all sorts of different angles and although politicians of a certain party and their supporters are quick to parrot that Colorado exemplifies the “gold standard” of election integrity, that very definitely does NOT appear to be the case after a close examination of Colorado’s voter roll, the rightful starting point for any such assessment of the quality of election integrity in this or any other state._
**[Tenth Circuit strikes down DOJ detention theory, ruling affects Colorado courts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sbv4054fb94)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s7re8b6aedd) Rigoberto Santillan Quiroz entered the United States without inspection in 2006. ICE arrested him at a traffic stop on November 2, 2025 and initiated removal proceedings on the ground that he entered without admission or parole.
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sdqbb63f9f3)**_
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Principles over popularity: Lessons from the Declaration of Independence for Douglas County Schools](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s0laf73cdfc)** BY LAUREEN BOLL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sbqc16eaed9) _Douglas County School District (DCSD) board members will be deciding later this year whether to resume formal collective bargaining with the Douglas County Federation (a local affiliate of the American Federation of Teachers), and a primary deciding factor will be the results of a survey of teachers and staff.****_
**[Volunteers bring America’s 250th birthday party to Grand Junction’s fairgrounds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s9t4ddb2354)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s4k588fc4e1) July 4 has always meant fireworks in Grand Junction. This year, a group of local volunteers think it should mean something more. Austin Dewitt, the event’s coordinator, had one goal going into it. “I wanted Liberty on the Lawn to be more than just another Fourth of July celebration,” he told RMV.
**[Federal Officials Say Jeffco Must Change Transgender Policies or Lose Federal Funds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s3k6673d18c)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s6ve6614dca) The U.S. Department of Education on Friday warned Jeffco Public Schools it has 10 days to correct alleged Title IX violations over the Colorado district’s transgender policy or lose federal funding.
**[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s8ncfcce8a3)**

|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Colorado primary delivers a warning conservatives shouldn’t ignore](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s6i19fc5016)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sfq15c8e0c1) _What happened in Colorado’s 1st Congressional District should get everyone’s attention. Democratic socialist Melat Kiros just defeated Diana DeGette, a 15-term Democratic incumbent who has represented Denver for nearly three decades. This was not a conservative beating a liberal. This was the activist left defeating the Democratic establishment from inside its own party._
**[Pride changed. I didn’t.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/scu0420e805)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s2ib1f416d6)** BY VALDAMAR ARCHULETA, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sfne0c8779c) _As the world wraps up another June, filled with rainbows and unicorns, I, as a gay Republican, reflect on 30 days of what always ends up being unproductive conflict. And once again, I prepare to face the inevitable question: “How can you be a gay Republican?"_
__
**[An open letter to Elon Musk](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s0r50916dfd)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s5q62bc6a25)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s3n4a75f366) _Dear Elon, You do not know me. I am one of millions of Americans who will likely never meet you, never stand on a launch pad, never design a rocket engine, never build a global company, and never appear in the history books._____
**_[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sao185fa15b)_**
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Energy Secretary Chris Wright makes the case for data centers, and admits they’re not for everyone](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sdj883f5978)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s7n7ac34987) U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright sat down on stage at Douglas County Fairgrounds and told a Colorado crowd that the data centers many of their neighbors are fighting will help cure cancer. Wright, the former Liberty Energy CEO turned 17th U.S. Secretary of Energy, joined Heidi Ganahl for an onstage interview at RMV Freedom Fest on June 27. __
**[Trump Welcomes Tina Peters to White House Following Colorado Prison Release](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/schaeb80d55)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s4occ599de3) Since her release from prison, Tina Peters has reemerged on the political circuit — appearing over the weekend at the GOP Freedom Fest in Castle Rock and then visiting the White House on Monday to meet with President Donald Trump.
**[Democratic Establishment Sounds Alarm Over Socialist Strategy Inside Party](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s4r8e092a48)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/ser5ff1f449)**[JUST THE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/sel15afc722) The Democratic Socialists of America have adopted a strategy to exploit the Democratic Party’s ballot access to boost their own candidates at the expense of incumbents, a plan which achieved remarkable success in New York City this week.

_**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-kQ/s9u522914d5)**_

It's a fascinating look at how today's environmental challenges were predicted years ago—and why forest management matters now more than ever. 🗳️ Just days before Colorado's primary election, the Republican National Committee filed suit against Secretary of State Jena Griswold, arguing the state's policy allowing certain overseas voters with no personal Colorado residency history to vote violates the Colorado Constitution's residency requirements. The lawsuit adds another chapter to Colorado's ongoing debate over election law and election integrity. 🎥 At Freedom Fest, independent journalist Nick Shirley shared how some of his biggest investigations began—not with anonymous sources or leaked documents—but simply by asking questions, showing up, and looking for himself. His message to Coloradans was straightforward: if something doesn't seem right, investigate it, ask questions, and never stop seeking the truth. As always, thank you for trusting Rocky Mountain Voice to tell Colorado's stories. In truth & liberty, Team RMV | | | | | TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK BY JEN SCHUMANN, Nick Shirley spent Saturday night walking the Freedom Fest audience through the questions that have taken him from hotels near Denver International Airport to empty daycare centers in Minnesota and apartment complexes in Aurora. BY JEN SCHUMANN, After Freedom Fest ended, Pueblo resident Randy Thurston was still talking his way through the weekend. Not in order. One speaker reminded him of another, and a story from Saturday connected to something he had heard Friday. He was not replaying the event. He was still putting it together. BY JEN SCHUMANN, By Saturday morning, Russ and Deb Minary were home, a refrigerator due to be delivered and an ordinary weekend resuming around them. They couldn’t stop replaying the day before. They almost hadn’t gone. | STATE BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, One of Colorado’s biggest races still isn’t settled. Two days after the polls closed, the Republican primary for governor had not been called. Victor Marx led Barb Kirkmeyer by about 2,000 votes statewide—39.86 percent to 39.43 percent, with Scott Bottoms third at 20.71 percent—in the Secretary of State’s Thursday morning count. Marx’s edge, 2,181 votes out of more than 500,000 cast, sits just outside Colorado’s mandatory recount range, which trips at half a percentage point. BY MIKE O'DONNELL, I’ve spent the last few months digging deeply into the Colorado voter roll from all sorts of different angles and although politicians of a certain party and their supporters are quick to parrot that Colorado exemplifies the “gold standard” of election integrity, that very definitely does NOT appear to be the case after a close examination of Colorado’s voter roll, the rightful starting point for any such assessment of the quality of election integrity in this or any other state. BY SHAINA COLE, Rigoberto Santillan Quiroz entered the United States without inspection in 2006. ICE arrested him at a traffic stop on November 2, 2025 and initiated removal proceedings on the ground that he entered without admission or parole. | LOCAL BY LAUREEN BOLL, Douglas County School District (DCSD) board members will be deciding later this year whether to resume formal collective bargaining with the Douglas County Federation (a local affiliate of the American Federation of Teachers), and a primary deciding factor will be the results of a survey of teachers and staff.** BY SHAINA COLE, July 4 has always meant fireworks in Grand Junction. This year, a group of local volunteers think it should mean something more. Austin Dewitt, the event’s coordinator, had one goal going into it. “I wanted Liberty on the Lawn to be more than just another Fourth of July celebration,” he told RMV. The U.S. Department of Education on Friday warned Jeffco Public Schools it has 10 days to correct alleged Title IX violations over the Colorado district’s transgender policy or lose federal funding. | COMMENTARY BY C. J. GARBO, What happened in Colorado’s 1st Congressional District should get everyone’s attention. Democratic socialist Melat Kiros just defeated Diana DeGette, a 15-term Democratic incumbent who has represented Denver for nearly three decades. This was not a conservative beating a liberal. This was the activist left defeating the Democratic establishment from inside its own party. BY VALDAMAR ARCHULETA, As the world wraps up another June, filled with rainbows and unicorns, I, as a gay Republican, reflect on 30 days of what always ends up being unproductive conflict. And once again, I prepare to face the inevitable question: “How can you be a gay Republican?" BY C. J. GARBO, Dear Elon, You do not know me. I am one of millions of Americans who will likely never meet you, never stand on a launch pad, never design a rocket engine, never build a global company, and never appear in the history books.___ | NATIONAL BY SHAINA COLE, U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright sat down on stage at Douglas County Fairgrounds and told a Colorado crowd that the data centers many of their neighbors are fighting will help cure cancer. Wright, the former Liberty Energy CEO turned 17th U.S. Secretary of Energy, joined Heidi Ganahl for an onstage interview at RMV Freedom Fest on June 27. Since her release from prison, Tina Peters has reemerged on the political circuit — appearing over the weekend at the GOP Freedom Fest in Castle Rock and then visiting the White House on Monday to meet with President Donald Trump. | | | | | A little over a year ago, Trump invoked a law no president has touched in half a century.

It gives the president absolute power to create a “shadow group” — invisible to Congress and the courts.

The last time a president used this law, America broke a global superpower without firing a single shot.

This new group works out of the Eisenhower Office Building. Its chairman has a permanent seat in the Situation Room.

And every move they’ve made points directly to one stock.

The same stock a $5 billion insider has bought 24 times — and sold zero.

Dylan Jovine met privately with two of the Congressmen tied to this group. He’s revealing the full story — and the ticker — today.

[See the stock the shadow group is targeting >>](https://links.notify.powerfieldnotes.com/u/click?_t=e11a13a19fbf4d1ab3d90eea26ea896f&_m=64765599f3fc4011896ea148f0229759&_e=y6VkBDrGRpDPFZDQs4UN7IuLYFVV9iACrgS6TshElgyk8PDCQJbh9wESVmzxb_vFT0gjC0broxbG92Z40CY03hmccFhQhN08stSYttvj2Bx5b_91sna5XRndw-FxF9xsBjFGZ0sfveAKNNqmWPaY-gys6Yt2nb2h9JcjuTfKP2jP5e3RmcT9eAvTESs9yBv40SQmbXh8KusZeOfIVW8J5mB5zYuLWiruZGDWtD_NYH4qd_Pp9QtnUjDzuiVCrjm3UqZqLDDl-BmAiJaXLmhoQ7vgcN_bb20KkfWK71lS_hK4k0iiAcHfpv2VcZ2BwLYtT9oe17ePgDIRaAwrH9rsWkMxjsWHb7ai9qXtwBS2N-C5ASpkLLa09rhcTAeo2npUKaNBSoN3O23hQ8ed6Lz7Y0kuBMehMMdWiN-tP4FRD0exVvmGDIdbqHZ1KPy62bNCYg3qFTaTuZNGM9WuE9ffieOxqf9MNXXkn-ZXNVIVhRA%3D)

“The Buck Stops Here,”
Kelly Maguire
Behind the Markets
---
|
---
| | **Warsh Ended Forward Guidance This Week. The Fed Telegraphed Its Moves for 15 Years. Now It Won’t. Here Is What That Changes for Every Bond and Equity Investor.**
---
| | At the ECB Forum in Sintra on Wednesday, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh confirmed that the Fed is abandoning forward guidance — the practice of telegraphing future rate decisions through dot plots, press conference language, and committee statements. He said the committee “agreed that forward guidance was not well suited to the current policy conjuncture” and announced task forces to reassess Fed policymaking from “first principles.” This is not a minor communications adjustment. Since Ben Bernanke introduced forward guidance during the 2008 financial crisis, the Federal Reserve has operated on the principle that predictable signals reduce market volatility. Under Powell, the framework reached its fullest expression: the Fed pre-positioned the market for moves it had already decided. **Warsh has ended that framework.** ECB President Lagarde said one of her biggest regrets was being constrained by forward guidance. Bank of England Governor Bailey warned that virtually anything central bankers say gets interpreted as policy guidance. This is a convergence among major central banks, not an idiosyncrasy.
---
| | The investment implication is structural and immediate. Under forward guidance, bond traders could position for rate hikes two to three meetings in advance with reasonable confidence. Without it, rate decisions become genuine surprises again. The October hike — currently priced at 67% — is a market inference from data, not a Fed commitment. Warsh can deliver it without any additional signal. Or he can skip it entirely if data flows dovishly, again without warning. **The 67% is your bet. It is not his promise.** This means the bond market’s advance pricing mechanism is structurally impaired. Term premiums — the extra yield investors demand for uncertainty — should rise on long bonds. 1–2 year T-bills at 4.5%, which mature before the full uncertainty horizon materializes, are now superior to long bonds not just tactically but structurally. The case for staying short-duration was always tactical. It is now also structural.
---
One additional consequence of the forward guidance removal is the elevation of the FOMC minutes’ importance. **Wednesday July 8’s release of the June meeting minutes is now the market’s best inside view of what the committee was actually thinking** — and with forward guidance gone, it is one of the only structured ways to gauge how close the October hike actually is. If the minutes reveal four or more dissenting votes toward a hike at June’s meeting, October odds move immediately higher despite Thursday’s soft payrolls. If the minutes show broad consensus for patience, Goldman’s no-hike scenario gains institutional support. In a world without forward guidance, the minutes replace the dot plot as the clearest signal available. Mark Wednesday July 8 as the week’s most important release, not just context.
---
| | Sources: InvestingLive ECB Forum Wrap, July 1, 2026 · Kiplinger, July 2026 · Schwab Market Update, July 2, 2026

Two hundred and fifty years since a group of men pledged their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor to the idea that no single person should have unchecked power over a free people, and to mark the occasion, Donald Trump put his own face on the American passport. **The one President who thinks he is King wants to put his face in every free American 's pocket.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b5df3547-b648-4def-b325-5973213fd0e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[STOP THE SHENANIGANS. CLICK HERE.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f228d5ab-f0c5-4252-a798-19d91ca56a0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
His face. His signature. On the document that represents every American citizen's place in the world. The Founders didn't fight a revolution so one man could brand a republic with his own likeness. Happy Birthday America!

Friends,
I hope you and your family had a wonderful 4th of July weekend. As we celebrate America's 250th birthday, one question echoes through our history:
Will the American story of self-governance, self-determination, and God-given, inalienable rights continue for another 250 years?
Our Founding Fathers declared that men are not the property of the state, but free souls under God, ruled by His law, not the whims of dictators or distant bureaucrats. This truth is the heart of the American experiment in liberty and freedom.
We live in the greatest country the world has ever known because of these freedoms. Those who don't like America fail to understand how our system of liberty and self-determination has delivered unparalleled success, prosperity, and human flourishing.
Last week, I stood along the roads in Powhatan County, Charlottesville, and others waving the American flag and wishing hard-working Virginians on their way to work a Happy 250th Birthday, America!
God bless you, God bless our troops, and God bless the United States of America!

## Trump Waits Out Storm for 250th Salute
President Trump [delivered his Salute to America](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAURp8GOyYIiFpQ_Mkfu9lst6VBuCqzVzFwnYlvv5l9ha2_5Ms55-s-3l3EuC8fbgNLcxp3eBUEIsjjWZ5lAlziuR3odiiUT_89XfMohTRctFyYMbiI16irYGcACaoCW7edUko2TV2ttg19a4yAKUhfz1qCbrq-l9I4I6ag-yra95tohamF6EV3gwANuN5PYBR0wTAtIERK-fZIcacVZrzSE_LNp61CuxIdhal_TA5MDm7yb4P3xuTwmTBS9IXJgfK5HXxNGHh2iBf3gDBlR8AfJ158Tmemlb9cWeO-UNqZHAqlfDE1xMDU_1pp1WqldJVtOF4RMRbTMi2WzUX8haE_FXxa-RMAAP__MzGGtA) address at 11:15 p.m. Saturday after thunderstorms chased thousands of spectators off the National Mall and pushed the program back nearly four hours. The president refused to reschedule. _"Storms bring luck to whatever the occasion,"_ he [posted](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0bHOozAQBOCngW4jxyRACopr0v3XXokWewhOFhvZBsTbn0h57VVbjPaTRvPnp_9hJ86_fvOMLo-h99iTIGfEfk1bGiAvt86LsEfKcTWf4Rh7rXRNqiFV95adHP2ttN0IaFQlumvTVlWl7_drOXXNoNrhPhjbQNm20e2jhmp1W42Ph2KL0nWnphpVX5V6qPYCizv4YQbUFVpbFzcF63KIl3dwPk8Y5Qgb4sWEuZRuynlJRfWr0M9CP_e38BkU-nk2KfRTgmE5E85moiUiOQufKcd1Xigt4E8iz9kFz0Izi9DoIvYQP4kshA9Y4hnRGSZ9V2QgGOL3gd6rHHSjcRU5KZiJNmcR_gFNDLtN5LzFAm_hDcjyQVMQd97EsmbQGAEbZsLGZv0CqYydXXYn4lLdFDf1mtnJt3n-r7m2Tv8NAAD__wD0slg), promising to speak even if it took until "2:00 O'Clock in the morning." Once onstage, he celebrated "[freedom's triumph over tyranny](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU8DmZGxwdCBg0066003RIVdNN4pG2QXIG4_6rnCxF__6en9e00vCBTS-y9EtLxsU8KrEDJjno5ylhnpHY64EyQsnA_3Nd_LpKQyQg5CmslDoHvqam8XRIW6RtsOo9Za9X1br7bTrVn82PUSRqOVg_nhvEE3em-Uc1AH-6HJQZpWyoccG_TYIzzcjEbj6E3VSfSBt9z830LiFRe6txNz47ZYk12Z91LpP5V6Vup5XVeT2H-2Sj05H3EXHimcmIuAiDk4EKqXouyIbhXAIgGHLQGJCEQCFsYseD2Sx1x4y_Hzh3tq235oVdesHKnO1u9XIArFDFUn3xEC_fjwryKeVn0HAAD__wWyiZw)" and honored veterans before a crowd serenaded by tenor Christopher Macchio and country star Lee Greenwood. A fireworks display billed as the nation's largest ever followed his roughly 40-minute speech, sending the crowd home after midnight.
## Floods Follow Deadly Holiday Heat Wave
A punishing holiday weekend of heat and storms now [gives way to flooding](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAUhZ8GOwzCiGNB8Td287dbmgtclVkUA9cxvv3GfYXtTnKSc_J9X6_xBSGGbf4PKxqa0rjhWSISYR6P8ikW4xyOdY-wYaF8uG97TaMUUnPRcaFHDyFe46PyZkKUqCo0TfdUSsm2barFiEmBlAC2bRoHjW6lVx58j6LtLTpdBXOviU7oRohePGv02CL0zqJW-PSaPQT6QCnX7xQ2WnCKV_pgrl1aq2gWor0w9Y_JgcnhPM_a2XJT3D2Twx2ZHBYE4oVSXgt_H_HiUzoyLdxhRJuBQtoK39OJmaeDYEYmhyobv58hxlB0xx5iXiHE31v6k6uPkT8BAAD__1-hgYk), with 34 million people in the Northeast under flood watches through late tonight. Philadelphia and New York City could see up to four inches of rain by Tuesday. Forecasters warn that storms parked over the same areas could dump more than [two inches of rain](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAUhJ8GOq-MWWApKNLQ3bQpkbHHu871D_I5YO3bRzfJG9x2ZjT69P362D60Dz49f-qIhV3eEioFMKNsJ120Izz9GY-gE4jLaT73t9uUVKOQk5DjZrUP7-3e2sUBCn2LpZsefd-rYeja1zLMMJ1zdzPse2_tLveh0xOAGb1TWrV--XqTkxw7KWf5uMFigJ7NjrHHw47NXcJ6zuX2O_vEL7jwzhfKzeTYhuXFfFDT_2jU2qi11nrTxpwVml__No1akRq1Ei4UiP_NV3DGiMI-QhDnEkm4kLP16SlsrunIZyHBWRwo5ImFT5xFQhUV-BTalEwkDBIXHQQ0MUoSJzVq7Wb5UMPUlsUe1YfgaZyau3xG7cNfbP6W62tRfwIAAP__yuOZZw) per hour, threatening this morning's commute from Washington, D.C., to southern New England. Record heat is suspected in [at least 25 deaths](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAYhJ9GOxwERSwo0thd2pQOwnpyQbkB1PHtM2byBin__9vZ2d2vx_jQzrvt-alXqDyHccOZPHJGHPd0pAn-6fb17fWGlONuvqdrHhllgtCOUDFa7fw1NqVVM8DAS6i6k5xz1rZ1uSgtp0ljMj1sLeu6p6yTjaYMEqIR0pRO3W60o6KmtKeygkUL3ZsJgkNaUTQU1uUQq1dwW14w-ysciJUJa-nVkvM7FfyjYEPBhvM8q20yd4ub3x_ovCAWbFigc8GGCBOiJfdF7A0TSTgQQf6kZA57zAt57f4i0Wyat5zSuozKvk_nvUuiKxr6XLXzvyHyv5Y7FPsJAAD__9MmhS8) from the Deep South to the East Coast, including 22 in New Jersey alone. Storms also knocked out power to [nearly 1 million](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGypCAURL9Gs2vhBRUDgk0mm003tFCuIzMIFuBQ_v2W7xde3t3V5_x7Tk9tnfWvv3onldcweSrJUc4UpzN900zuZc_9cNpTyvFcPvO1TsiwBzYA6yejrbsmURu1EiHxmlQ7SM45dl1bb0rMQoqRmZVji6PsjJxxQNRyNsvKJdVW3WtsYH3L2MhkQ4Y60uMyU89Jmr4SjIzNITbvYH3eaHVX-FJslrDXTm05H6nifyp8VPgopTQ3QiH63IEKH7s-IG2hJCgbRQJPOroLWtitczZ40DtFu2ifQEeCYvMWzgxHKBQheHif7gIBLbbdMDBRR2WOcldTP1SCvXZt3c-X_CuBX4X_AwAA__8luocq) homes and businesses at the weekend's peak, with Michigan hit hardest as crews raced to restore service.

Hello, I hope that your summer is going great. I had a lovely 4th at a friend's barbecue.
As you know, I ran for President in 2020 with the main idea that AI was going to come along and do a number on jobs. I believed that advancing Universal Basic Income was the best hope that we had of managing this transition. I wrote a book, The [War on Normal People](https://substack.com/redirect/c3d916f6-23df-47fe-a192-c614f28cf77c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), making this case and then stumped around the country for months rousing millions of Americans. You might have been one of them.
How am I feeling now?
I've been reading a lot of the work compiled by the economist [Molly Kinder](https://substack.com/redirect/0b01fc53-a931-42c9-8a75-3b1414bc8620?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), whom I recommend. She, like [Clara Shih](https://substack.com/redirect/646fafb0-43fd-49b1-95f6-7de2c5dac046?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), believes that even if AI doesn't wipe out all of the jobs, we are in for "a hard, messy period of concentrated pain with job losses clustered in specific, desirable jobs. . . the work that AI is most[ directly capable of replacing is cognitive work](https://substack.com/redirect/781effce-b389-433f-8eaf-461c984cb571?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) performed at a computer - in offices and professional sectors. These are precisely the jobs that have grown the most as a share of the American labor force over the last fifty years."
Here is one of her favorite charts, which shows the general trends in the types of work that most Americans do:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd4679d0-14f1-4473-9627-83564c3d1b17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Farmers famously went from 40% of workers to 1% of workers in the last 140 years.
Office and administrative jobs peaked around 1980 and are now declining.
Services jobs peaked in 2015 or so and are now declining.
Meanwhile, professionals have grown to be almost half of all jobs. 'Professionals' is used very broadly in this particular study: it includes managers, marketers, business and finance operations, coders, mathematicians, architects, engineers, lawyers, teachers and educators, journalists, scientists, dietitians, doctors, nurses, health technicians, accountants, librarians, social workers, guidance counselors, artists and designers, actors, physical therapists, etc. You can see the source data [here](https://substack.com/redirect/f23dda0d-782b-4c2a-8acc-1c87aae662be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Pretty much anything that requires a college degree gets lumped into this category. College graduates are about 36% of the population of the U.S. and 45% of the workforce.
Molly describes this decades-long transformation of the labor market as increasing rewards for cognitive skill, accruing largely to college graduates. "First, agriculture collapses as a share of employment over a century. Blue-collar manufacturing rises and then falls. Office and administrative support rises and then drops. And through it all, professional and managerial work climbs steadily upward. The skill premium has been one of the most durable features of the modern economy."
Molly then forecasts that AI is about to extract the premium from cognitive work. "If cognition itself becomes commoditized, the scarcity premium that has rewarded the college-educated knowledge class for generations starts to compress. The chart I keep staring at is the one I'd want to draw next: the same occupational clusters, projected forward, with the professional band starting to bend downward for the first time in a century . . . What we face is not a transition to a stable new shore. It is an economic transformation of historic scale, one that threatens the best jobs we have and the very notion of work as we know it."
Yup. AI is going to sharply reduce the number of professionals in the economy. It's starting with [recent college graduates](https://substack.com/redirect/646fafb0-43fd-49b1-95f6-7de2c5dac046?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the rank-and-file of banks and [tech firms](https://substack.com/redirect/99691279-b453-4090-adb2-24e942544e6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but it's going to expand very quickly.
What do we do for a living? A lot of us think. The thinking is going to be done for us more and more by AI. Imagining that this won't transform the nature of work is fanciful.
Molly is particularly concerned about clerical and backroom jobs that serve as paths to the middle class for millions. And, to her credit, she doesn't think retraining is a viable solution for most workers.
How do I feel about the case I made back in 2020? It's aged well. I wish I was wrong, but I don't think I was. The question is what, if anything, are we going to do about it.
I've been interested in what we could do with money for a while now. For my interview with financial journalist Brendan Greeley on his [book](https://substack.com/redirect/9da2be8d-236a-432e-9beb-fe28b3f1dd46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "The Almighty Dollar: 500 Years of the World's Most Powerful Money" click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/025a6168-96b6-4bbd-9a0d-1e187da62a32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Hey y'all,
I’m reaching out to you today because I believe in the incredible work my colleague and fellow progressive, Rep Gabby Salinas (D-Memphis), is doing for her community and our state. Gabby is a passionate advocate who fights every day to protect our values, support working families, and create opportunities for everyone. I’ve known her for over ten years and have seen her take on tough fights; we met when we were working on Medicaid Expansion together. As someone who knows firsthand the challenges we face here in TN, Gabby’s dedication to championing education, healthcare, and economic justice is exactly what we need in these critical times. But to continue this important work, Gabby needs our support in her reelection campaign.
Gabby fights tirelessly for everyone in her district and across our state. She stands up for the people when courage is required as she did when together, we walked to join our colleagues and lock arms during the special session, taking a united stand against the supermajority’s theft of black voting power in Tennessee.

Can you join me in standing with Gabby by making a contribution or signing up to [volunteer on her campaign](https://us.list-manage.com/10d7p0iZGW_?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)? She needs your help as her team ramps up voter contact heading into this critical time before the primary. Every dollar helps her amplify our voices and build a better future for all of us.[Donate Now]: [Gabby Salinas — Donate via ActBlue](https://us.list-manage.com/udrsEL2Iug_?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) Together, we can make a difference. Rep. Gloria Johnson

##### **JULY 6, 2026 | THE WAR ROOM | DISPATCH #7**
### **My fellow patriots of District 11, my fellow Floridians, my fellow Americans --**
Go to your kitchen table. Put your hand on it.
That table is where you practice freedom. Morning coffee before the house wakes. Homework help after a shift. Bills spread out after dinner. Conversations you share nowhere else. Decisions that shape your future--whether your household includes children and a mortgage, or simply you and the quiet of a home you have spent a lifetime paying off.
Now imagine an intruder at that table. No knock. No request for permission. He is holding a bill, and he is telling you that you owe more this year than last. More than you budgeted. More than you can afford. And if you do not pay, he will take your house.
That intruder is not a thief. He is the system. And he has come to feast at your kitchen table--uninvited, unaccountable, and insatiable.
* * *
### **THE NUMBERS THE BUREAUCRACY WILL NOT SHOW YOU**
The mortgage is fixed. Everything else is rising.
In 2024, the median monthly cost for homeowners with a mortgage hit $2,035--up 7% in two years, outpacing inflation. The typical homeowner now spends 21.4% of income on housing costs alone. Before food. Before healthcare. Before life.
But here is what they do not want you to see: the mortgage is not what is crushing you. It is everything attached to it.
70% of homeowners with a mortgage pay $1,000 or more per year in insurance alone. Not property taxes. Not utilities. Insurance.
1 in 10 pays $4,000 or more per year--$333 per month before the mortgage, before anything else.
Even if you own your home free and clear--no mortgage, no bank, just you and the deed--57% of you still pay $1,000+ per year in insurance. The mortgage is gone. The extraction remains.
In Florida, where the GAO says premiums rose 25% or more above inflation, these numbers are worse. Much worse.
The bureaucracy has the data. They are just not showing you what is eating your kitchen table.
* * *
### **THE EXTRACTION**
The black box is not just in Washington. It is global.
63.8% of the reinsurance market is foreign-controlled. 30 to 50 cents of every premium dollar you pay flows to entities you cannot see, influence, or hold accountable. The Senate Budget Committee confirmed that $36.8 billion is extracted annually from the U.S. economy by foreign reinsurers.
The Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas confirmed the extraction: reinsurance rates increased 107% between 2019 and 2024. That 107% is your wealth, leaving your table, extracted by a system you did not design and cannot vote out.
That is not a pricing problem. That is extraction.
* * *
### **THE THEFT BY SPREADSHEET**
In Winter Garden, one family's flood insurance premium leapt from $2,800 to over $4,300. A federal algorithm guessed their first-floor height was one foot. A tape measure proved it was three. Their appeal was met with a form letter. Their choice was a new premium or a new mortgage.
That is theft by spreadsheet. And if it hasn't reached your table yet, it's coming.
* * *
### **THE STRIKES**
After six months of boots-on-the-ground investigation, research, and policy development, I am running for Congress because the root must be struck--and I am the candidate in this race with the architecture to strike it.
Three strikes. One mission.
**Strike One: The REINS Act.** No agency writes a rule that costs you money without your representative voting on it.
**Strike Two: The Administrative Independence Act.** You get a real day in court, not a kangaroo tribunal run by the same agency that harmed you.
**Strike Three: The Sunshine Mandate.** I will question. I will speak. I will expose. Every premium, every rule, every reclassification that transfers your control to those you cannot vote out will face the light. I will use the full power of the office to open the records, demand the answers, and publish the truth. When the REINS Act passes its look-back provision, every regulation I have exposed dies.
Secret rules. Secret tribunals. Secret extraction.
President Trump is wielding the executive order to cut this rot. But executive orders expire. Laws do not. The bureaucracy must be struck at the root -- and that requires Congress.
The purpose is not reform. The purpose is restoration of constitutional order.
* * *
**Strike the root. Secure the table.**
**Vote Palomo on August 18, 2026.**
**Ivette Palomo**
Farmer. Whistleblower. First Responder.

And he has come to feast at your kitchen table--uninvited, unaccountable, and insatiable. THE NUMBERS THE BUREAUCRACY WILL NOT SHOW YOU The mortgage is fixed. Everything else is rising. In 2024, the median monthly cost for homeowners with a mortgage hit $2,035--up 7% in two years, outpacing inflation. The typical homeowner now spends 21.4% of income on housing costs alone. Before food. Before healthcare. Before life. But here is what they do not want you to see: the mortgage is not what is crushing you. It is everything attached to it. 70% of homeowners with a mortgage pay $1,000 or more per year in insurance alone. Not property taxes. Not utilities. Insurance. 1 in 10 pays $4,000 or more per year--$333 per month before the mortgage, before anything else. Even if you own your home free and clear--no mortgage, no bank, just you and the deed--57% of you still pay $1,000+ per year in insurance. The mortgage is gone. The extraction remains. In Florida, where the GAO says premiums rose 25% or more above inflation, these numbers are worse. Much worse. The bureaucracy has the data. They are just not showing you what is eating your kitchen table. THE EXTRACTION The black box is not just in Washington. It is global. 63.8% of the reinsurance market is foreign-controlled. 30 to 50 cents of every premium dollar you pay flows to entities you cannot see, influence, or hold accountable. The Senate Budget Committee confirmed that $36.8 billion is extracted annually from the U.S. economy by foreign reinsurers. The Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas confirmed the extraction: reinsurance rates increased 107% between 2019 and 2024. That 107% is your wealth, leaving your table, extracted by a system you did not design and cannot vote out. That is not a pricing problem. That is extraction. THE THEFT BY SPREADSHEET In Winter Garden, one family's flood insurance premium leapt from $2,800 to over $4,300. A federal algorithm guessed their first-floor height was one foot. A tape measure proved it was three. Their appeal was met with a form letter. Their choice was a new premium or a new mortgage. That is theft by spreadsheet. And if it hasn't reached your table yet, it's coming. THE STRIKES After six months of boots-on-the-ground investigation, research, and policy development, I am running for Congress because the root must be struck--and I am the candidate in this race with the architecture to strike it. Three strikes. One mission. Strike One: The REINS Act. No agency writes a rule that costs you money without your representative voting on it. Strike Two: The Administrative Independence Act. You get a real day in court, not a kangaroo tribunal run by the same agency that harmed you. Strike Three: The Sunshine Mandate. I will question. I will speak. I will expose. Every premium, every rule, every reclassification that transfers your control to those you cannot vote out will face the light. I will use the full power of the office to open the records, demand the answers, and publish the truth. When the REINS Act passes its look-back provision, every regulation I have exposed dies. Secret rules. Secret tribunals. Secret extraction. President Trump is wielding the executive order to cut this rot. But executive orders expire. Laws do not. The bureaucracy must be struck at the root -- and that requires Congress. The purpose is not reform. The purpose is restoration of constitutional order. Strike the root. Secure the table. Vote Palomo on August 18, 2026. Ivette Palomo Farmer. Whistleblower. First Responder. This article addresses Familial Security: Demolishing the Home Insurance Crisis. Peter, I’m not sending this message to everyone.

I’m specifically reaching out to you, because as my team and I were going through our supporter records, your file stood apart.
You’re one of my best-informed grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest from our campaign. Thank you.
**I am so grateful for your time and attention, and today, I’m asking you to take the next step. Here’s why:**
Unlike my Trump-backed MAGA opponent, I’m not a Washington DC insider relying on my billionaire connections to buy my way to victory. I’m depending on people like you – who believe in building a better future for our country and give what they can to help out when it matters most.
_Right now is one of those moments._
With President Trump personally attacking me and GOP super PACs pouring just shy of $100 million into North Carolina so far to defeat me, the polls are tightening. **If we don’t have the resources to fight back and surge ahead, we’ll put our chances of flipping this seat in jeopardy.**
[**That’s why I’m asking, Peter: Will you chip in your first $5 donation to help us win in North Carolina and take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk774&amount=5&t=8&akid=1967%2E124072%2Esx41d0)

Roy

Former Congressman and two-term Illinois Governor Rod Blagojevich (D), former President Barack Obama (D), and Senator Dick Durbin (D-IL). (Associated Press)
By Mark Vargas, Editor-in-Chief^†
For nearly eighteen years, one of the most significant documents from one of Illinois’ most consequential political corruption cases has remained hidden from the American people: the FBI FD-302 summarizing former President Barack Obama’s December 2008 interview in the Rod Blagojevich investigation.

On December 9, 2008, more than two dozen FBI SWAT team members and a hostage negotiator arrived at the home of Illinois Governor Rod Blagojevich and arrested him on allegations that he was attempting to sell the U.S. Senate seat vacated by President-elect Barack Obama.

The first trial ended without a conviction on the Senate-seat allegation, leading to a second trial.

Blagojevich and his supporters – including this author – have long argued that prosecutors withheld exculpatory evidence, selectively presented recorded conversations, and built a misleading narrative that distorted what actually occurred.

The controversy surrounding the case did not end with the verdict. In 2015, the U.S. Court of Appeals overturned several of Blagojevich’s convictions, including the cenerpiece of their case – the so-called “sale of the Senate seat,” while leaving convictions related to political fundraising requests intact to preserve his 14-year prison sentence.

On February 18, 2020, President Donald Trump commuted Blagojevich’s sentence after he had served eight years in prison. On February 10, 2025, President Trump granted him a full presidential pardon.

Even today, the case continues to generate debate.
^†Publisher and General Counsel Scott Kaspar joins in this opinion piece.

Lead Story · Iran
IRAN BURIES KHAMENEI AS ITS NEW “SUPREME LEADER” HIDES FROM VIEW — AND THE CROWDS CHANT “DEATH TO AMERICA”
What's Happening
Iran has begun a six-day state funeral for Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who was killed alongside several family members in the February 28 U.S.–Israeli strikes that opened the war. Hundreds of thousands packed Tehran on Sunday, many weeping and beating their chests — and many chanting **“Death to America”** and **“Death to Israel.”** Some hard-liners openly called for the assassination of President Trump.
The Situation
* **The new “supreme leader” was a no-show.** Khamenei’s son **Mojtaba** , named to succeed him, has not been seen in public since the war. He is reported to have been badly wounded in the strike that killed his father — his face disfigured and at least one leg seriously injured — and Israel’s defense minister has said he is “marked for death.”
* Three of Khamenei’s other sons — Mostafa, Meysam and Masoud — prayed beside the coffins, joined by President Masoud Pezeshkian and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf. Authorities say they expect roughly **15 million** people across the multi-day processions.
* Trump said the U.S. gave Iran **“a week off”** for the funeral, and talks over a permanent end to the war appear on hold until the mourning wraps up Thursday.
* The **Strait of Hormuz** is still contested: tracking data showed at least eight ships making U-turns Saturday after trying to slip through by hugging the Omani coast.

The Perspective
Step back and look at what’s actually on the screen: a regime that just lost its “supreme leader” — and, by Trump’s account, its entire navy — is staging a week of “Death to America” theater while its new figurehead is either too injured or too frightened to show his face. That is not the posture of a winner. The ceasefire is holding on American terms, and the Hormuz workaround this newsletter has tracked for weeks is still forcing Tehran’s hand. The honest caveat: chants of revenge aren’t nothing, and the real test is whether Iran uses the funeral as an excuse to walk away from the table. Watch what they do when the mourning ends.

AFTER TRUMP PRESSED XI, CHINA FREES A PERSECUTED PASTOR — WHO LANDS IN L.A. ON THE FOURTH OF JULY
What's Happening
Pastor **Ezra Jin Mingri** , founder of Beijing’s underground Zion Church, has been released from Chinese detention and arrived in Los Angeles on **July 4** , reuniting with his family for the first time in years. His freedom came less than two months after President Trump personally raised his case with Chinese leader Xi Jinping during a state visit to Beijing in May.
The Situation
* Jin and 17 other church leaders were detained last October in one of China’s largest crackdowns on a single congregation in decades, and charged with “illegally using information networks.”
* His family called the release “a miracle” and thanked Trump, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and the dozens of members of Congress who signed letters demanding his freedom.
* Jin founded Zion in 2007; it grew into one of China’s largest independent churches before the officially atheist Communist Party banned it in 2018 for worshiping outside the state-approved system.
* The win is partial: advocates note that **at least eight** Zion leaders remain jailed, and the case of Hong Kong publisher Jimmy Lai — serving a 20-year sentence — remains far tougher.

The Perspective
A Christian pastor walks free on America’s 250th Independence Day because an American president decided religious liberty was worth putting on the table in Beijing — not in a speech back home, but face-to-face with Xi. That is what leverage looks like when it’s actually used. Credit where it’s due, and a dose of realism too: eight of Jin’s colleagues are still behind bars, and Beijing doesn’t hand out goodwill gestures for free. One family reunited is a genuine victory. It isn’t the finish line.

America at 250
STORMS, RECORD HEAT, AND A LATE-NIGHT SPEECH: TRUMP MARKS AMERICA’S 250TH ON THE NATIONAL MALL
What's Happening
The nation turned **250** over the weekend, and the marquee “Salute to America” event in Washington got a rocky sendoff. Severe storms forced an evacuation of the National Mall, pushing President Trump’s address to nearly **11 p.m.** — on what turned out to be the hottest July 4 on record in D.C., with a preliminary high of **102°F**.
The Situation
* Trump honored veterans and Medal of Honor recipients on stage and displayed historic flags, including a 1777 banner and one he said had draped Abraham Lincoln’s coffin.
* He declared this “only the dawn of the **golden age of America** ,” insisting “the best is yet to come.”
* He likened communism to a cancer — “you’ve got to cut it out” — a jab at the democratic-socialist wave in recent Democratic primaries, and again pushed the **SAVE America Act** (proof of citizenship and ID to vote, limits on mail-in ballots), which is stalled in Congress.
* Weather bit hard nationwide: roughly **150 million** people were under heat alerts, and cities including Philadelphia scrapped or shortened events. D.C. still attempted a record 40-minute fireworks finale, and Trump had spoken a night earlier at Mount Rushmore.

The Perspective
Two and a half centuries in, Americans stood in triple-digit heat and rode out an evacuation order just to cheer their country’s birthday — that says something the cynics keep missing. Critics will call the speech too political for the Fourth, and it’s fair to say a citizenship-and-ID voting push isn’t standard fireworks fare. But requiring proof of citizenship to vote polls well outside the Beltway, and honoring veterans and the founders on the 250th is hardly controversial. The rain delayed the show; it didn’t dampen the crowd.
[Read the full story at CBS News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/kjr52jvV4c7x5o%2BUa74Oe6cmVZ17yqTOxZF8g1BeLsOTJV2tr1iK5NDzlzLB%0A8iOyx3gpoRHsdNT%2BtX81wDF29z%2Bbv%2FdgkCR0V1CdH2cfVeqz%2FsaY%2B0wGne%2Fo%0AA9qI4DTvSBGipMoNe9ImU%2FvEHY880RNOKMIs%2FmYoNtFBjLMdCXwNkhiDZ5ku%0A8GbssFk8julTGSNWCRQzbJ3S0P4cJASIeg%3D%3D%0A/2ee94b044d31e081)
The Economy
JUNE JOBS COME IN HALF AS STRONG AS EXPECTED — AND MORE AMERICANS ARE LEAVING THE WORKFORCE
What's Happening
The economy added just **57,000 jobs** in June, the Labor Department reported — roughly half the 113,000–115,000 economists had penciled in. The headline unemployment rate actually ticked _down_ to **4.2%** , its lowest in a year — but the reason is the catch.
The Situation
* The rate fell largely because people **left the labor force**. Participation dropped to **61.5%** , the lowest since 2021, and the household survey counted 507,000 fewer people at work.
* Prior months were revised down — April and May combined lost **74,000** jobs from earlier estimates.
* Wages rose 3.5% over the year, still **below** the latest 4.2% inflation reading — the third straight month paychecks have trailed prices.
* Leisure and hospitality shed 61,000 jobs. The Federal Reserve, now under new Chairman **Kevin Warsh** , left interest rates unchanged.

The Perspective
Don’t let the falling unemployment number fool you — it dropped because Americans gave up looking, not because they found work. That’s the opposite of a healthy labor market. And with wages losing to inflation for a third month — inflation still fueled in part by the Iran war’s pressure on fuel prices — families feel the squeeze no chart can hide. In fairness, 4.2% unemployment is still historically low, and several economists read this as “stabilization” rather than a slide. But stabilizing at low hiring, shrinking participation, and pay that won’t keep up isn’t the boom anyone was promised.
[Read the full story at Fox Business](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/bnjM%2F00gJC0y53SFU5zRiWga1PGKgS32uQ6zwDwvqZ400uggWO9%2F%2FW8BExSD%0AoK8mJH5Q6g%2F9e0E3m3NhWI4nTI6fARsnHZBa7jGLa0sHFNmHrlKbgfdyCQW9%0A8jVmHlBr9Wou38nIkOdQo4CMxaU8%2F0TNXFIHgP97D63GWY8WeB0sz8rW4Nve%0As3s6cHdCNqUoEc%2FDIA69U9ZRkz53Azhk1A%3D%3D%0A/55b375534e5057d1)
⚡ The Bottom Line
Iran is burying its slain leader with a week of “Death to America” chants while his wounded successor hides — a show of rage from a regime negotiating from weakness. A persecuted pastor is free in Los Angeles because an American president pressed Xi face-to-face. America celebrated 250 years through heat and storms without blinking. And back home, the June jobs report flattered to deceive — unemployment “fell” only because workers stopped looking, with paychecks still losing to inflation. **Strength abroad, faith rewarded, a country that still shows up for its own birthday — and an economy that needs more than a friendly headline. That’s just the truth.**

name: Dudley Brown
subject: What the UN quietly did while you weren’t watching
body:
A message from the National Association for Gun Rights and Sen. Rand Paul – on a treaty Washington, D.C. hoped you’d forget.
---
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e896133/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvNEQ4UkI2bjJ2cQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDY/LbmNsNFpMU1I3Rw/qP2hpZHM9bmNFbThTN2plU21lalBscw/gakutHw/scs476f11ee)
| | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | |

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations’ “Small Arms Treaty” has been the Gun Control Lobby’s crown jewel since Barack Obama sent it to the U.S. Senate and insisted we ratify it a decade ago. Year after year, we refused.

_But each and every day, the UN is getting closer to implementing the terms of this dangerous Treaty’s provisions here in the United States, even without ratification_.

**And it’s all being done in secret by the UN’s allies in the Washington, D.C. “Swamp.”**

The good news is, you and I have a chance to stop the Gun Control Lobby cold.

But it’s an opportunity that won’t last forever.

That’s why – as Dudley Brown, President of the National Association for Gun Rights, explains in the message below – [it’s absolutely critical you and I act now](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e896133/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuZ3VucmlnaHRzLm9yZy9zYi11bmd1bnRyZWF0eS8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDY/LbmNsNFpMU1I3Rw/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yNjA1MjYmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1yZXZzaGFyZSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXNiJnV0bV90ZXJtPTIzMjM5X3dyMSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD10ZXh0X2xpbmsx/gakutHw/s0t22518f14)!

**Sincerely,**

**The Hon. Rand Paul
United States Senator (R-KY)**
* * *
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e896133/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuZ3VucmlnaHRzLm9yZy9zYi11bmd1bnRyZWF0eS8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDY/LbmNsNFpMU1I3Rw/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yNjA1MjYmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1yZXZzaGFyZSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXNiJnV0bV90ZXJtPTIzMjM5X3dyMSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1sb2dv/gakutHw/s6uaf0075c1)
Dear Patriot,

There is a sword hanging over the head of every American gun owner.

I’m referring to the UN “Small Arms Treaty” – the first stage of the UN’s global gun control agenda.

My name is Dudley Brown. I’m the President of the National Association for Gun Rights – America’s no-compromise gun lobby.

And I’ve spent the better part of my life fighting the gun grabbers wherever they show their faces – whether that’s a statehouse in Denver, on Capitol Hill, or a marble-floored conference room at the United Nations in Geneva.

In fact, I’ve stared these global gun banners in the face and told them what they could do with their precious “Small Arms Treaty,” though I knew the UN would NOT like me crashing their “Gun Ban Club” in Geneva.
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e896133/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuZ3VucmlnaHRzLm9yZy9zYi11bmd1bnRyZWF0eS8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDY/LbmNsNFpMU1I3Rw/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yNjA1MjYmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1yZXZzaGFyZSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXNiJnV0bV90ZXJtPTIzMjM5X3dyMSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1pbWFnZTE/gakutHw/sdjde669153)
_**I told UN bureaucrats you and I will NEVER surrender to their anti-gun schemes!**_

When I told these anti-gun international bureaucrats they were walking in the footsteps of every 20th-century murderous dictator who disarmed their citizens to shuffle them off to death camps, I guess my words hit a little “close to home.”

All these monsters could do in response was squirm in their seats and laugh nervously . . .

But here’s the thing. You, I, or even President Trump can tell these gun grabbers what we think of their treaty all day long. It doesn’t matter.

Until somebody fights back with the resources to actually stop them, this Treaty sits there – pending, waiting, ready to be ratified the moment the gun grabbers have the votes.

[That’s why I’m counting on you to chip in your most generous contribution to the National Association for Gun Rights IMMEDIATELY to help us shut this thing down for good.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e896133/VaHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUuZ3VucmlnaHRzLm9yZy9zYi11bmd1bnRyZWF0eS8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDY/LbmNsNFpMU1I3Rw/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yNjA1MjYmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1yZXZzaGFyZSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXNiJnV0bV90ZXJtPTIzMjM5X3dyMSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD10ZXh0X2xpbmsy/gakutHw/scpf19b86f8)

Because as long as the UN “Small Arms Treaty” remains pending in the Senate, ratification by a future Senate is all that’s needed for this gun grab to become reality.

_And that’s REGARDLESS of who occupies the White House or their position on the Treaty_!

With this Treaty, the UN’s goal is to DESTROY the legal buying, owning, manufacturing, and selling of pistols, rifles, and shotguns by FORCING: **> >> _ALL countries involved in the export of firearms – including the United States – to establish a “National Control System_.”** This is nothing more than GUN REGISTRATION, plain and simple – the first step toward outright GUN CONFISCATION;

**> >> _ALL firearms manufacturers who seek to export firearms to ask for permission and report on how they believe the guns they sell will be used_.** The UN ultimately wants final say on whether or not any firearms transfer should be allowed. Period. After all, they know guns in the hands of the “wrong” people is the biggest threat they face toward imposing their brand of one-world socialism around the globe; and
